en.title: MTA Zoning Boosts Subway Accessibility; Veterans Bus Launches
en.summary: The New York MTA is using a zoning program to fund elevator and ramp upgrades at subway stations, aiming to improve accessibility for disabled riders. Simultaneously, a new wheelchair-accessible bus is enhancing transit for veterans with mobility challenges, and the HHS has released a Q&A guide ahead of its July 8 medical equipment accessibility deadline. Additionally, the Canadian Human Rights Commission urged inclusive AI development, while new Dutch apartments integrate accessibility features.

zh-TW.title: 紐約MTA運用zoning提升車站無障礙；退役軍人巴士上線
zh-TW.summary: 紐約MTA透過zoning計畫撥款，改善車站電梯、坡道等無障礙設施，以提升殘障乘客出行便利。同時，新輪椅無障礙巴士提升退役軍人交通服務，且HHS於7月8日截止前發布醫療設備無障礙問答。荷蘭在建公寓聚焦無障礙設計，而日本推文顯示智能障礙學生挺身對抗欺凌，獲得同學讚賞。
